source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Record the date, time, and location of the inspection.
3. Identify the specific building or area that failed the fire safety check.
4. List the items that failed the inspection along with detailed descriptions – be specific about the exact nature of the failure (e.g., inoperable fire alarms, blocked fire exits, lack of fire extinguishers, etc.).
5. Describe the severity of the failure and any potential impact it could have on life safety.
6. Include the names and titles of the inspectors who conducted the check.
7. Document any communication or warning issued to the building management, including the date and time.
8. Attach any photographs or videos that demonstrate the failed checks (if applicable).
9. Record any immediate actions taken to mitigate the hazard (if any).
10. Outline recommendations for remedying the issues.
11. Note any scheduled follow-up inspections or deadlines for resolving the identified issues.
12. Summarize the overall status
